line.name: Diamond Crown
line.description: Not on the site. J.C. Newman's flagship prestige/long-aged Dominican line, originally introduced over a century ago and reintroduced in 1995 for the company's centennial. Made at Tabacalera A. Fuente y Cia using double-fermented, long-aged Connecticut Shade wrapper. (Note: I could not verify a claimed Ernesto Perez-Carrillo connection to this line - flagging as unconfirmed rather than stating it as fact; may be a conflation with a different J.C. Newman collaboration.)

not_added_flag.issue: This photo depicts the real 'Diamond Crown 2024 Holiday Collection 3-Cigar Sampler with Leather Case' - but that sampler contains 2x Diamond Crown Cameroon Belicoso + 1x Diamond Crown MAXIMUS Belicoso (both 6.75x54), NOT the No.4/No.5 vitolas also photographed. Not added as a vitola entry since it's a mixed sampler of different sub-lines (Cameroon, MAXIMUS) not otherwise researched here; flagging its real identity for your awareness. Exact price/release date unverifiable.

research_notes: The Classic line's full size range per jcnewman.com: No.2 (7.5x54), No.3 (6.5x54), No.4 (5.5x54), No.5 (4.5x54), No.6 (6x64), No.7 (6.75x54), No.8 (5x58), No.9 (6x50) - no 'No.1' appears in current listings, possibly retired. Only No.4 and No.5 were photographed on the Mac, so only those are added as formal vitola entries here.
